taste.name: Display-led decision points
taste.trigger: When a visitor needs to understand the product proposition
taste.decision: Uses a 72px/700 display headline over keeping all text in the body face
taste.reason: The decision is visible before the visitor enters the long product narrative.

taste.name: Blue fields, neutral reading surfaces
taste.trigger: When separating high-stakes product moments from supporting material
taste.decision: Uses #011369 as a full field while retaining #FFFFFF content surfaces instead of tinting every section blue
taste.reason: The blue field creates a page-scale change in attention without reducing reading contrast across the whole page.
evidence: page sections include rgb(1, 19, 105) and rgb(255, 255, 255)

taste.name: Rounded action vocabulary
taste.trigger: When a control must look immediately actionable
taste.decision: Uses 12–24px component rounding and 9999px on compact action links over square controls
taste.reason: The shape distinguishes things that can be acted on from editorial content without a heavy border system.

taste.name: Whitespace over enclosing every statement
taste.trigger: When a long landing page must hold many product categories
taste.decision: Uses 40px, 48px, 80px, and 96px section padding instead of turning every block into a bordered card
taste.reason: The long scroll stays legible because each new concept gets a visible reset point.
evidence: primary surface is white with transparent section backgrounds
